rationale: Power intent is per-implementation, not protocol-level

extraction_strategy.ic_class_applicability_gate_v0_1_62: ic_class='serial_peripheral_protocol' declares LL21 not applicable; emitted as N/A stub (l_doc_taxonomy.na_stub)

power_relevant_features: Link rate scaling (1-128 GFC) trades power for bandwidth.
OFFLINE / not-operational state (OLS) when the link is idle/down.
Optical vs copper FC-0 media have different transceiver power profiles.
fields.notes: Fibre Channel does not define a formal low-power/power-intent framework as a protocol concept; power is an HBA/controller and transceiver implementation concern. The dominant knobs are the selected GFC rate and the media (copper vs optical).
